rows.title: The Lavender Hill Mob 2011, directed by Charles Crichton | Film review
rows.comment: Charles Crichton’s direction is subtle but inventive
rows.verdict_le10: Charles Crichton’s direction is subtle but inventive
rows.dek_lead: Charles Crichton’s direction is subtle but inventive – check out the snaking, near-single-take opening in a Rio cabana – and the performances, writing and plotting are faultless.
